༄༅/ /gtor bsngos khyer bde'i rigs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa phrin las bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtor bsngos khyer bde'i rigs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa phrin las bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las ye shes ka pā lar// 'bru gsum 'od zhu zag med pa'i// bde chen bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur// mchod yul skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa// dran mchog mgon po rdo rje can// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes bzhes mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub bde blag nyid stsol zhing*// phyi nang bar chad nyer 'tshe zhi// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub byin rlobs// zhes pa gnas mdo karma rnam rgyal la spel/// / ༈ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'od 'phros pas// mchod rdzas zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// kun bzang pad 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// dran mchog bla ma'i ngo bor gsal ba la// mchod pa 'bul bzhes mchog gnyis dngos grub stsol// sdig sgrib kun byang bde chen dag zhing du// skyes nas phyir mi ldog par sangs rgyas shog / ces si tu pas dad gsum ldan pa bsod nams bkra shis pa'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ rab 'byams mtha' yas gtor gzhong du// snang srid dngos kun mchod rdzas gtams// 'bru gsum byin brlab sbyang spel nas// ye shes bde chen skyed byed gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hrīḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'phrul// gdod nas lhun grub sku gsum gyi// bdag nyid chen po padma 'byung*// rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas dang*// 'gro rnams 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i// yang dag don bkod bcom ldan 'das// yid bzhin 'chi med mchog stsol ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams// rang bzhin dbyings las rjes dgongs la// deng 'dir mchod phyir gnas 'dir byon// srid zhi'i dngos kun mi bzad pa// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la// thugs brtser bzhes la dgyes par rol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// bka' yi srung mar dam bcas pa'i// lha sman rgyal mo mched lnga po// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma dang*// rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bzhin du// bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung skyob mdzod// rnal 'byor las bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs// nongs par gyur rnams dag tshangs gsol// gnas skabs mthar thug bde ldan zhing*// mchog tu mi 'gyur sku brnyes nas// rtag par bkra shis kun khyab shog

/ ces pa'ang karma phun tshogs ngor spel/// / ༈ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i brag /pad nyi zhing chen bsnol ba'i steng*// hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'bar ba las// don gnyis byas te yongs gyur pas// dpal ldan rdo rje nag po che// dud kha mun chen mdog ltar gnag /rngams brjid srin po khros pa'i zhal// ljags 'dril mche gtsigs hūm̐ pheṃ sgrogs// dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan// khro gnyer spyan gsum phyag gnyis kyi// gri gug bhandha khrag bkang gsol// sku la 'jol ber dgu brtsegs dang*// stag sham gser sked rin chen mdzes// mgo rlon do shal dug sbrul brgyan// zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs ye shes kyi// me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros// rang bzhin ye shes dbyings dkyil 'khor// byang phyogs dur khrod chen po nas// ma hā kā la lcam dral tshogs// 'khor bcas spyan drangs dbyer med gyur// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ stong las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// thod par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// 'od 'phros dam ye dbyer med pa'i// bdud rtsir byin rlabs rgya mtshor gyur// hūm̐/ bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma 'khor tshogs bcas// mchod par 'os pa'i mchod 'os rgya mtsho rnams// mdun mkhar sprin bzhin bzhugs la mchod pa 'bul// rtsa brgyud kun 'dus ma hā kā la mchod// yi dam kun 'dus rdo rje ber can mchod// dpa' bo ḍā ki dam can kun 'dus pa'i// chos dbyings gdod ma'i he ru ka dpal mchod// dngos su 'byor dang yid las sprul pa yi// phyi nang gsang mchod rten skong sgrub pa'i rdzas// ma tshang med pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs kun// mchod bya mchod byed bral ba'i ngang nas mchod// bstan la mi sems rang rgyud 'khrul dbang gis// srung ma bskul zhing rtsa ba dang yan lag

/dam tshig nyams chag bshags so dag gyur cig /ye shes las dang 'jig rten cir yang sgyur// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong rgyal// 'khor bcas bstod do gang bcol phrin las mdzod// khyad par bde chen byang chub bsgrub pa la// sdong grogs smin cing grol bar rgyud byin rlobs// bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor la 'tshe ba'i// nag po'i rtsa lag pha mthar bskrad pa yi// mngon spyod drag po'i mthu rtsal bstan du gsol// bdag cag tshe dpal 'byor rgyas chos mthun gyi// yid la re ba'i 'bras gang 'phel ba yi// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// de ltar mchod bstod dge bas rnam pa kun// mi 'bral 'grogs shing nyer 'tshe'i g.yul rgyal nas// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang se tsha bla ma karma chos rgyal gyi bzhed ltar/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge// / ༈ mchog gsum kun 'dus ngo bo nag po che// rdo rje ber can lcam dral bka' 'khor bcas// rnal 'byor dam tshig can la dgongs su gsol// deng dus snyigs lnga'i las dbang gyur pa yis// bstan dang bstan 'dzin yongs la 'tshe byed pa'i// ma rung log 'dren gzugs can gzugs med rnams// snying rjes bsgral ba'i thabs kyis rjes bzung nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa dri med rin po che// de 'dzin byed dang dge 'dun gtsug lag bcas// skyong ba'i thugs rje'i thugs dam ma g.yel bar// rnam pa kun tu skyabs su brten lags na// yal bar 'dor med phrin las drag po yi// phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mdzad du gsol// ces pa'ang rta rna bla ma karma thub bstan gyi bzhed ltar/ si tus spel ba madga laṃ/// / ༈ oṃ ā bighnan gyi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid gyur de'i ngang las// rlung mes mtshan pa'i thod sgyed steng*// ā las ye shes kā pa lar// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros// oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ye shes bdud rtsi char ltar babs// dam ye dbyer med bdud rtsi gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs dur khrod 'jigs rung bzod dka' dang*// byang shar chos dbyings pho brang dam pa nas// ye shes mgon po ma hā kā la che// dpal ldan sras mchog rdo rje ber nag can// yum mchog dbyings kyi rgyal po srid gsum bdag /'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo re ma ti// dbugs len bcu drug phyogs bcu skyong ba'i mgon// dregs pa don gnyis rtsal ldan dregs pa gsum// ma mo bdun dang sring bzhi 'bar ma dgu// dus bzhi lha mo dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi// dbang mo nyer brgyad brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// 'khor dang sprul pa yang sprul bye ba 'bum// sngon gyi thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig /ri bo ral zhing chu gter 'khrugs pa'i klong*// bskal pa'i me 'bar drag po'i hūm̐ sgra sgrogs// skad cig yud tsam spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ sogs spyan 'dren sngags brjod/ sra brtan lhun chags brag steng padmas brgyan// nyi ros mtshan pa'i gdan dang phyogs kun tu// rno dbal mtshon chas gtams pa'i gzhal yas su// ci ltar bde ba'i ngang du bzhugs su gsol// hūm̐/ yi dam kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// chos skyong kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// khyad par chos skyong ber gyi na bza' can// dpal ldan lha mo rang byung rgyal mo ni// mched lcam 'khor dang bcas la mchod par bgyi// hūm̐/ snod bcud snang srid zag med mchod pa'i sprin// dngos 'byor rgya chen blo yis blangs nas su// dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nag po che// lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la de wī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings klong nas mi bzad gtum po'i sku// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i drag shul can// nag po yongs kyi gtso mchog khyod la bstod// rdo rje drag mo kun gyi gtso mo ste// ma cig lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod// sngon tshe thog med dus nas thugs bskyed pa'i// zhal bzhes tha tshig gnyen po dgongs mdzod cig

/rig 'dzin padma thod phreng dpal chen po// karma pakshi rtsa brgyud bla ma yi// dam tshig ma g.yel phrin las myur sgrubs mdzod// bstan dgra thal ba'i rdul ltar brlag pa dang*// gang bcol thogs med myur ba nyid 'grub cing*// rgyal bstan rin chen phyogs mthar spel ba dang*// 'gro rnams chos ldan legs pa'i lam gnas shing*// bkra shis kun khyab rdzogs ldan dpal spyod pa'i// bkra shis dam pa'i bdud rtsis sim gyur cig / ye shes pa gshegs/ zhes pa'ang zab mo'i gter 'chang karma rnam rgyal rdo rje rab brtan nas lha rdzas bcas bskul ltar/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dza yantu/// / ༈ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi dngos// dam tshig bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// ye shes chen por byin brlab nas// hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i klong*// 'gags med sprul bsgyur du ma yi// rol gar rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// rgyud sde bzhir 'brel yi dam lha// gnas gsum dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// khyad par rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dpal// ma hā kā la rdo rje ber// lha mo dam zhing la sogs pa// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud dang*// rdo rje gdan mchog karma pa'i// gnas bdag dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas// lha klu gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong*// mchod sbyin 'di bzhes skyabs yul rnams// dgyes bskang bla med thob par mdzod// 'jig rten skyong rnams tshim pa'i mthus// yid la gang bsam 'dod don kun// gegs med 'grub pa'i stongs grogs mdzod// rtsa gsum 'dus pa nag po che// gang des tshe rabs thams cad du// rjes 'dzin byang chub chen po yi// 'bras bu mngon du byed gyur pa'i// bde legs nyi ltar rab gsal shog / ces lha bris pa sbyin pa'i ngor spel/ sarba madga laṃ/// /

༈ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las thod snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// hūm̐ yig mang po 'od zhu mchod ba'i rdzas// kun bzang mchod sprin rgyun mi chad par gyur// mchod yul dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// ye shes mgon po rdo rje ber nag can// yab yum 'khor bcas 'dir byon gnas 'dir bzhugs// sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas brten rdzas bskang ba'i rdzas// dngos po'i bye brag sna tshogs snang srid kun// 'gengs pa'i mtha' klas brjod bral dgyes mchod 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'gal ba bshags// chos dbyings gdod ma'i drag po he ru ka /ma hā kā la 'khor dang bcas la bstod// rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin brgyud par bcas// zhabs brtan 'gro la phan bde'i char chen stsol// gnod byed tshogs kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal pa'i// bka' drin dam pa'i bdud rtsis 'tsho gyur cig / karma sbyin pa mthar phyin ngor spel/// / ༈ mgon po ber gyi bzhes 'bod gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs/ ho/ dgongs su gsol lo// gsan du gsol lo// chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa'i ngang las/ ma 'gags thugs rje'i rang rtsal las grub pa'i ye shes chos skyong kun gyi mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa/ dpal chen he ru ka 'bar ba'i khro bo chen po/ shrī ma hā kā la 'jigs byed rdo rje ber nag po can dang*// 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma rang byung srid pa'i rgyal mo dpal ldan lha mo lcam dral yab yum/ gzhan yang dam can rdo rje legs pa/ zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu la sogs pa ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi mgon po/ dam pa chos kyi bka' srung dregs pa'i gtso bo/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ 'khor dang yang 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la phrin las su bcol ba'i mdo ni/ spyir dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa bshigs pa/ chos 'khor gnyan po'i dbu 'phang smad pa/

gsang sngags ston pa'i brgyud pa bcad pa/ 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde bshigs pa/ mtshams med lnga dang mi dge bcu'i sdig la rngams pa/ khyad par du'ang dpal ldan karma pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa rnams dang*/ bye brag tu rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral bdag cag slob mar bcas pa'i sku la bsdo zhing tshad btsugs pa/ ya bzung zhing sma 'bebs pa/ snga dgra lag brdar gyis sbyor rtsub byas pa/ da dgra thad btsug gis bsam ngan log lta 'chang ba/ phyi dgra zhe la gnon pa'i g.yo sgyu mgo bskor gyis sel 'jug phung sems shoms pa/ dpa' ba'i dpung bskul/ 'gras tshol bsnyad 'dogs kyi sdang sems dang ldan pa/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po bdag gi sgos dgra/ gzhan yang gnod byed 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa rnams dang*/ pha rol gyi byad ka /phur kha/ rbod gtong*/ sbyor ngan btang pa'i byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad rang gshed rang la phob cig /rang srog rang gis bcad pa'i bsam pa phyin ci log tu thong zhig /dam nyams pa'i dgra po 'di rnams kyi nye du nye 'brel rigs rgyud kyi rgyab brten srung skyob dang bcas pa'i gnas lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang dang bcas pa thams cad/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams la gnyer du gtad do// sngon gyi zhal bzhes thugs dam tha tshig rjes su dran par mdzod la/ bstan dgra dam nyams ma rungs pa 'di rnams kyi ming rus rjes shul tsam yang med par da lta nyid du thal ba'i rdul phran rlung gis gtor ba bzhin du rmeg nas med par rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las dam pa ma g.yel bar/ drag po dpal gyi gtor chen dregs can bye ba 'bum gyi dmag tshogs rnams dang*/ nad mtshon bu yug gnam lcags thog ser gyi rnam pa 'di yi mthu rtsal nus pa'i rngams zer rdzu 'phrul rdo rje'i me char drag po dang bcas te/

dam nyams dgra bo 'di rnams kyi steng du phob cig /myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces stong nag sprul sku phun tshogs rab brtan gyis bzhed ltar/ si tu pas spel ba kun tu dza ya/ sarba madga laṃ/// / ༈ na mo shākya mu na ye/ 'dir gnod sbyin ngal bso chen po'i rgyun gtor khyer bde nyung ngur bya ba 'dod pa dag gis/ dkar gsum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas tshogs par byas nas 'di skad do// oṃ las rin chen las grub pa'i// snod mchog yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i// rgya chen zad mi shes par gyur// a kā ro

sa byin gyis brlab/ bai/ byang phyogs mnga' dbang bsgyur mdzad pa'i// gnod sbyin rgyal po rnam thos sras// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir bshams padma'i gdan la bzhugs// khyod la mchod pa'i bye brag ni// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// kun bzang smon lam las grub pa// zag med rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin// nor bdag yab yum 'khor bcas la// dgyes pa'i rdzas mchog phul ba'i mthus// ston pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// rgyal khams lo legs chos dang ldan// rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod pa'i 'bras// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las bzhi'i phrin las gang yin pa// myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// sa brgyad dbang phyug rgyal chen po// btsun mo sras 'khor bstod par 'os// nongs par gyur kun dag tshangs stsol// bkra shis dge ba'i dpal ldan shog /badzra muḥ zhes gshegs gsol bya/ bsngo ba smon lam spyi mthun bya'o// zhes gnod sbyin dbang po'i mchod phreng 'di bzhin bslab pa gsum ldan lcog ro sprul sku karma bde chen rab 'phel gyis bskul ba ltar padma nyin byed dbang pos 'phral du bris pa phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /dza yantu/// / ༈ de nas rgyal chen rnam sras/ jo bo sngags bdag srin mgon rnams kyi mnga' gsol ni/ thog mar rnam sras la/ mchod rdzas rnams/ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha nas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba yid du 'ong ba rnams kyi nang du/ gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum lha klu mi'i dpal 'byor sna tshogs pa dag cing gtsang la zad mi shes pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par gyur/ rdor thal kha gyen bstan/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ya/

i daṃ ba liṃ grihṇan tu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ ma ma sarba karma siddhi a mo gha swā hā/ lan gsum/ 'khor rnams la/ oṃ aṣṭa nā ga sha dhu ta sā ta sra ko ṭi yakṣa rakṣa sa swā hā/ gong bzhin i daṃ btags la phul/ bai/ bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi// rnam 'phrul sa brgyad sems dpa' mchog /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// khams gsum dbang bsgyur lha yi lha// rgyal chen rnam mang thos kyi sras// btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang*// bka' nyan nor bdag chen po brgyad// lha klu gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs// 'khor bcas dam tshig dbang gis ni// 'dir gshegs mnga' gsol mchod pa bzhes// srid pa gsum gyi longs spyod las// lhag pa'i phyi nang gsang ba yi// mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa// zhing khams rgya mtshor rgyas 'gengs pa'i// dngos 'byor mchod pa'i bye brag tshogs// spyan gzigs dkor chas dpag med rnams// yid sprul blo yis blangs nas su// 'bul bzhes dgyes pa bskang gyur cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// sems can bde skyid 'byung ba dang*// rnal 'byor tshe dpal ye shes spel// mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen sgrubs// 'dod dgu lhun grub 'byor pa rgyas// phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis stsol// gsol lo mchod do// rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos sras/ ri rab byang phyogs kyi mnga' bdag chen po/ gnod sbyin nor lha yongs kyi rje bo/ btsun mo sras dang bka' nyan sde brgyad/ lha klu srin po la sogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo mchod do// gsol zhing mchod pa'i mthus/ bla ma'i sku tshe bsring zhing bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dod dgu'i longs spyod dpal 'byor thams cad char bzhin 'bebs pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ sngags bdag ni/ klu sman sogs mchod rdzas rnams 'du byas la/

a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ bcud lha dang mi yi longs spyod sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐/ lan gsum/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi char bzhin du bab cing dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed par byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ a kā ro sa lan gsum byin brlab la/ hūm̐/ ri rab lho phyogs ma dros na// rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri steng nas// klu yi rgyal po sog ma med// klu chen mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis mchod phyir spyan 'dren na// dam tshig dbang gis gshegs nas kyang*// rin chen padma'i khri steng du// brjid cing 'gying bar bzhugs su gsol// hūm̐// stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// lha rdzas dge ba'i mchod gtor 'di// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// dag gsal dri zhim legs ldan pa'i// dri chab bdug spos me tog sogs// klu rgyal khyod la 'bul lags na// bdag gi las rnams grub par mdzod// yid 'ong legs sbyar ro ldan pa'i// sbrang rtsi dang ni shing tog sogs// klu rgyal khyod la 'bul lags na// bdag cag 'khor bcas bkra shis mdzod// phun tshogs dbyibs legs yid 'ong dang*// yid 'dzin sgra snyan rol mo dang*// dri zhim yid 'ong phun sum tshogs// 'bras chan la sogs zhal zas dang*// 'jam mnyen mdzes pa'i na bza' sogs// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bdag gi bsam pa 'grub pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar mdzod// gsol lo/ mchod do/ mnga' gsol lo/ jo bo sngags kyi bdag po/ 'jig rten mthu chen/ srid gsum tshar gcod/ 'gro drug dbang sdud/

khams gsum bdag po/ gsod byed chen po/ sbrul mgo bdun pa// zur phud lnga pa/ khye'u chung gzhon nu/ gzhon nu mdzes pa/ gzhon nu gtum po/ nag po chen po/ bdud po chen po/ klu rgyal sog ma med/ las mkhan chen po/ bran po chen po// g.yog po chen po// khol po chen po/ khyod kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la// bdag gi bran po'i tshul gyis shig /bdag gi g.yog po'i tshul gyis shig /bdag gi las mkhan gyi tshul gyis shig /sngags kyi bdag po khyod kyis bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin gyis shig /nā ga ra dzā dga' ba dang dgyes par gyur cig / ces 'bul/ srin mgon ni/ mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥbi ghnān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ste/ oṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par gyur/ a kā ra ོsa lan gsum byin brlab la/ bhyo/ nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na// lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// bstan pa'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can// thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol// srin po bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi thugs dam dbang gis ni// dam las ma 'da' da tshur byon// dgyes pa chen pos bzhugs su gsol// oṃ/ dpal chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// legs par brgyan cing bshams pa'i mchod gtor rnams// mthun rdzas 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab// dbang po lnga yi tshim byed bdud rtsi'i gter// rgya chen zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod// zag med bde ba bskyed pa'i mchod sprin du// ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags kyis byin brlabs nas// rnal 'byor gus pa'i yid kyis 'bul lags na// thod phreng yab yum 'khor bcas spyan lam du// ci 'dod mkho dgu'i longs spyod sna tshogs pa// chos nyid rnam dag lhag bsam bden pa'i mthus// rgyun du thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/gsol lo mchod do// mnga' gsol lo// dpal ma hā kā la srin mgon thod pa'i phreng ba can/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing*/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra bla/ bstan pa'i bka' srung chen po/ snang srid zil gyis gnon cing*/ ma rungs thal bar brlag pa/ yum srin mo 'jigs byed 'bar ma dmar mo/ thogs med mthu rtsal stobs dang ldan cing*/ sha la dga' zhing khrag la rngams pa/ 'khor du srin mo za byed rngams pa'i cha byad can bye ba 'bum gyis bskor nas khams gsum khyab par rgyug cing gang la dmigs pa skad cig tsam gyis rlag par byed pa khyed rnams gsol lo mchod do// mnga' gsol lo// gsol zhing mchod pa la brten nas sgrub brgyud nges don snying po'i bstan pa rin po che srung ba dang*/ spel ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las rnam pa bzhi thogs pa med par bsgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ rgyal dbang rin po cho mchog gi bka' bstsal rten 'byung ched du bkod pa'o// de nas dam zhing dang*/ trakshad mnga' gsol dang spro na 'dir mkhar nag sogs bya'o/// / ༈ snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtse chen ye shes kyi// tshad med phrin las thugs rje'i snying po can// gdul byar yang dag lam ston sprul pa'i sku// dpal ldan ye shes snying po'i thugs dam bskang// ye shes chen po'i rnam par rol pa'i 'phrul// rdo rje gsum ldan sku brnyes rgyal kun gyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i rje btsun mchog /mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje'i thug dam bskang*// chos kyi 'khor los sgyur pa'i bdag nyid che// don kun grub pa'i ring lugs rgyas pa'i gnyen// don gnyis stsol ba'i mchog dngos sbyin mdzad pa// dpal chen chos kyi don grub thugs dam bskang*// byang chub mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur kyang*// rdo rje lta bu'i gzugs sku'i rol pa can// bstan dang 'gro ba'i rgyan gyur dam pa'i mgon// rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*// yongs rdzogs chos kyi gzhung lugs ma lus pa'i// gtsug lag kun gyi 'byung gnas thams cad mkhyen// snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron me si tu pa// karma bstan pa'i nyin byed thugs dam bskang*// bdud 'dul byams pa'i go cha rab brtan cing*// rdo rje gdengs pas snang srid zil gnon pa// ngur smrig tshul 'dzin byang chub sems dpa'i dpal// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*// chos rgyal grub pa yongs gtso phrin las kyis// rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab la dbang bsgyur pa// gar gyi dbang po rā ga'i cod pan can// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// chos dbyings zab gsal rang mdangs las// lhun grub bde chen ngo bo nyid// ye shes snying po'i thugs dam bskang*// kun khyab spros dang bral ba las// rang bzhin gzugs sku'i rnam rol pa// ye shes rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*// 'gyur med 'od gsal rang byung las// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// chos kyi don grub thugs dam bskang*// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rang bzhin las// sprul sgyur gar gyi rol pa can// byang chub rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*// zab don chos kyi gter chen po// snyigs ma'i bstan 'dzin zla bral ba// chos kyi 'byung gnas thugs dam bskang*// lnga bdo'i gdul byar rjes dgongs nas// brtse chen ye shes thugs rje'i bdag

/bdud 'dul rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*// gdul dka' 'gro ba'i snang ngo ru// sna tshogs phrin las sgyur ba'i dpal// chos grub rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// bka' brgyud bskang chen gyi kha 'gengs su skyabs che dge slong tshe dpag nas bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod// yangs shing rgya che'i nang rol du// oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon tshogs/ brten rdzas bskang rdzas bsgrub pa'i rdzas// rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur// hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings las khro bo'i sku// gtum po dregs can 'dul mdzad pa'i// mngon spyod phrin las drag po'i sku// ma hā kā la phyag bzhi pa// yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// 'dod yon zag med mchod pa'i sprin// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// dngos 'byor yid sprul 'di dag kun// lha chen 'khor bcas dgyes par rol// bstan dgra thal bar brlag pa dang*// bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// rnal 'byor phrin las gang bcol ba// thogs med yid bzhin bsgrub tu gsol// bslu chos bdud po'i yid can gyis// 'gro la 'tshe ba'i bar gcod rnams// ming med rjes shul med par mdzod// mdor na rdo rje slob dpon gyi// bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar// dpal 'byor srid zhi'i dge legs kyi// bkra shis char chen stsol bar mdzod// ces pa'ang brtson 'grus nas bskul phyir spel/// / ༈ na mo padmā ka ra ye/ 'dir dgongs gter lha thams cad kyi gtor bsngos byed par spro na/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// a las mtshan ldan ka pā la// nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// so so'i sa bon mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig bdud rtsir dbyer med gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ

lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'od zer 'phros// chos dbyings bde chen rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dang*// dag pa mkha' spyod sa spyod zhing khams nas// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das lha tshogs rnams// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// mdun mkhar dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur// hrīḥ skye med chos sku 'od snang tshe mtha' yas// gos dkar yum bcas longs sku 'gags med 'phrul// spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul sku thugs rje'i rtsal// padma 'byung gnas khri srong lde'u btsan// dam pa sangs rgyas thugs kyi rdo rje mchog /rtsa brgyud bla ma bka' babs chos bdag dang*// che mchog dbang drag padma kī la ya// gsang bdag hya gṛ wa sgrol dkar ljang*// ser dmar don grub lha lnga lo gyon ma// 'od zer can dang khyung chen dzaṃ lha nag /king kang dmar po dbang phyug yab yum dang*// legs ldan tshogs bdag dpal mgon ma ning nag /a phyi bkra shis tshe ring dpal lha mo// ge sar spom ra thang lha sprag btsan gnyen// jag me rdor legs ye brdzu klu dga' po// mdo rgyal la sogs bka' gter srung ma'i lha// 'khor dang yang 'khor sprul dang yang sprul tshogs// khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// nyer spyod 'dod yon la sogs phyi mchod dang*// sman gtor rakta gsang ba bde stong mchod// dmigs med brjod bral de bzhin nyid kyi mchod// snang srid 'khor 'das ye dag rang byung ba'i// kun bzang gdod ma'i rol gar rig rtsal las// cir yang shar ba'i sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul gyi// skur bzhengs ye shes dang ni las 'jig rten// dpag med sprul pa'i mchod 'os rgya mtshor bstod// ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang bzod par gsol// bstan pa yun gnas bstan 'dzin 'tsho gzhes gsol// dge 'dun sde rgyas 'gro rnams bde ldan zhing*// rnal 'byor yang dag byang chub bsgrub pa la// sa lam yon tan gong 'phel tshe bsod rgyas// las bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol g.yel med sgrubs// mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin bstsal du gsol// mi mthun 'gal rkyen phyi nang bar chad zlog
/zab don snying po'i sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i// rnam kun bkra shis dpal dang ldan par shog /

mchod yul rnams rang gnas su gshegs pa'am/ rten la bzhugs gsol bya/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su/ sarba bhū ta gatstshaḥ brjod la gshegs gsol byed/ ces pa'ang 'jang la shrī rtogs ldan dpal 'bar gyis bskul ba ltar si tu pas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ lha rgyal ni/ dbang drag khro bo rol pa'i mngon spyod kyi// phrin las mthu yis nyon mongs dug lnga yi// cho 'phrul dgra dpung bdud kyi g.yul ngo las// sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas// dkar phyogs kun kyang rgyal lo su dza ya// mchog gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rgyal gyur cig / ces dgongs gter bla ma drag po'i lha rgyal si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos brjod pa'o/// / ༈ na mo padmā ka ra ye/ gnas chen seng gnam brag gi rtsa gsum gsol skong spro ba dag gis/ mchod rdzas gtsang zhing yid 'ong 'du bar byas la lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ hrīḥ rang nyid skad cig padma thod phreng rtsal// gsal ba'i thugs las 'od 'phros mchod rdzas rnams// rgya chen zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod// kun bzang smon lam ji bzhin sprin spro gyur// oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ kyai/ 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gnas// gdod nas rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas// rtsa gsum lha tshogs rab 'byams dpag med rnams// deng 'dir mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rol mo ldir// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang*// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid dkor chas rigs// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ji snyed pa'i// rgya chen longs spyod mtha' yas zhing khams kun// gang bar dmigs nas 'bul gyis dgyes par rol// lha tshogs gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam gnyen po bskang*// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// rtsa ba yan lag dam las 'gal gyur rnams// mi 'chab mi sbed mthol bshags bzod par bzhes// tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rmad byung thugs rje'i rang bzhin mi bzad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid 'chang de yi// sa gsum 'gro ba ma lus skyabs pa'i gnyen// lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi// de ltar mchod bstod bshags pa'i bsod nams kyis// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde 'phel rgyal khams yongs la dge// snyigs lnga'i rgud pa ma lus bsal ba dang*// rnal 'byor tshe bsring dpal bskyed longs spyod rgyas// las bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// rgyal khams bde zhing nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi// char chu dus bab lo legs 'bru rnams 'phel// phyi nang bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mdor na bsam don chos bzhin yongs 'grub pa'i// bkra shis mchog gis rnam kun khyab gyur cig

/ de nas gtor mgron rten la bzhugs gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs dang*/ mchod spyin gnas sogs/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// dad ldan sngags 'chang a bkra'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ yul gzhi'i bdag por mchod gsol bya bar spro na/ mchod rdzas/ a kā ro sa byin brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki sogs kyis bsngos la/ kyai/ rdo rje 'dzin mchog rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs bcas rnams// dad mos gdung bas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// rin chen seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// bstan pa bsrung la mi 'da'i dam tshig can// nus pa'i rtsal ldan sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mkhan// sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' dran mdzod la// ma thogs myur bar gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// gu ru dhe ba dhā kki na dharma pā la u pa si ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ de nas dge bsnyen la gtor ma 'bul ba/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ a las thod snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// ngo bo dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// rnam pa 'dod yon lnga ldan ba ling ta// brjid ldan drag po'i rdzas kyis brgyan pa 'di// bstan srung dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dgyes par bzhes la bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// u pa si ka i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos rnams thams cad sogs/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs/ bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bskul lo bskul lo bstan srung dam can bskul// drag po'i skur bzhengs rno ba'i mtshon thogs bskul// bstan dgra dam sri pho mo bsgral phyir bskul// thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo ma g.yel cig /sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la// dngos brgyud bsam sbyor gnod 'tshe byed pa kun// srog chod snying phyung dbang po nyams par gyis// gal te khyod kyis brlag par mi nus pa'i// dam log dmod pa'i mthu ldan yod srid na// gsang bdag khro rgyal rdo rje 'dzin khros nas// mthu stobs nus pas khyod la byin brlabs mthus// ban bon mthu chen rang gshed rang la phob// ming rus rjes shul med par rdul du rlog

/grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan karma pa'i// rdo rje'i bka' gsang rin chen cod pan mchog /khyod kyi spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa yi// ji srid g.yar dam ma bsnyel dam tshig can// sgrub brgyud bstan pa bsrung pa'i dus la babs// srung skyob mel tshe ma g.yel dus= zhing bcu dgra bo sgrol ba'i dus la= mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i dus la= thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma ya// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul la/ sarba gatstshaḥ rang gnas gshegs/ zhes si tu pas chos mdzad bla ma karma bstan pa dar rgyas pa'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ kyai/ dpal chen 'khor lo sdom pa yi// gnas mchog karma'i chos 'khor gyi// bka' srung rdo rje'i dam tshig can// dge bsnyen dpal ldan shes rab ni// 'khor tshogs sprul pa yang sprul bcas// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor tshogs// skong rten sgrub rdzas ma lus pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa rnams// 'bul gyi dgyes pa chen por rol// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las kyi// las bzhi'i 'dod don gang gsol ba// ma g.yel ma 'da' las mdzod cig /nyin mtshan rtag par sdong grogs dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyor// skye dgu bde zhing skyid pa yi// bkra shis yongs la khyab par shog / ces gdan sa chen po 'og min karma'i bla ma sprul sku pas bskul ba ltar/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos bgyis pa dge// / ༈ kyai/ rgyal bstan chos 'khor 'di nyid kyi// gnas bdag yul lha zo dor gnyen// dkar po lha yi sde dpon che// dkar ldem dpal rtse sras yum 'khor// yang sprul dpung tshogs ma lus dang*// mdud lung dge bsnyen la sogs pa// legs dang rgyal kha btod pa yi// yul ris sa phyogs 'di nyid la// gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams// 'dir gshegs gtor ma 'dod yon gyi// sprin phung zag med rgya chen po// 'bul bzhes dgyes bskang nongs pa kun// bzod bzhes rnal 'byor bsam pa'i don// 'bad med yid bzhin lhun grub mdzod//

ces skyabs che dge bskos dar rgyas sogs 'dus pa 'ga' zhig gi ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ hrīḥ snang srid dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul can// lha chen yab yum dgyes bskang phyir// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// mkha' dbyings gang ba'i 'od 'phro ba// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon dang*// chu skyes thang skyes me tog dmar// a dkar tsandan bdug pa'i spos// rab gsal snang byed nyi ltar 'tsher// dag byed dri chab kun tu dkrigs// ro ldan zhal zas tshar du dngar// grag stong dbyangs snyan rol mo dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// 'dod yon lnga dang bkra shis rdzas// rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang*// dung dkar bum pa bzang padma// dpal be'u 'khor lo rgyal mtshan te// mi dbang rgyal srid bdun la sogs// gling bzhi gling phran dpal 'byor rnams// thams cad blo yis blangs te 'bul// khyad par skong sgrub brten pa'i rdzas// tshang zhing yid 'ong gtsang sbyar 'di// dbang phyug ma hā de wa dang*// lha mo u ma de wī sogs// 'khor dang bcas kun dgyes par rol// thugs 'gal nyes pa'i nongs pa rnams// bshags so tshangs par stsol ba dang*// khams gsum srid pa'i mes po mchog /mchod cing thugs dam bskang ba'i mthus// rgyal bstan srid mthar gnas pa dang*// 'gro ba log par gol ba rnams// yang dag lam la dkri ba'i phyir// bdag cag sgrub por mthu nus kyi// rtsal rdzogs bsam don chos bzhin du// 'grub pa'i yid kyi 'dod 'jor mdzod// nad gdon bar chad mi mthun zhi// tshe bsod ye shes rgyas pa dang*// khams gsum srid bcud dbang du gyur// zhing bcu thal bar brlag par mdzod// rtag par mnga' thang dpal 'byor pa// rab rgyas bde legs char chen phob// ces pa'ang bla ma tshe ring nas bskul bzhin dgongs gter lha chen mchod phreng du si tus spel ba dza yantu/// /
